lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: patterns.md bullet marked `[resolved 2026-08-02]` (full-date form) doesn't match the archiver's `[resolved YYYY-MM]` regex

nextStoryContext: US-R1-004 was the last remaining round-1 review finding (priority 4, WARNING). Root-caused both halves of the finding rather than just reformatting the date: the `[resolved 2026-08-02]` bullet at patterns.md (the isSidecarArgv name-agnostic-matching entry, US-004/CAM-482) was UN-marked as resolved instead of having its date format corrected to `[resolved 2026-08]`. Reasoning: reformatting the date would have made `cam patterns archive` correctly pick it up on its next run and relocate it to patterns.archive.md, but the finding itself flagged that this specific bullet documents the LIVE `isSidecarArgv` shape contract (still the current production matching mechanism in src/commands/stop.ts), not a one-time resolved mechanic like the sibling GOTCHA it closes -- archiving it would have removed active knowledge from the grep-on-demand patterns.md that future stories touching stop.ts rely on. Fix was a single-line edit: stripped the `[resolved 2026-08-02] ` prefix from the bullet (restoring its bold-title formatting to match sibling live bullets), left the rest of the bullet's body text untouched (including its now-partially-stale '2 or 3 elements' shape claim, which line 1158's bullet already correctly flags as stale in its own prose per this file's established append-only journal convention -- corrections are made via a new appended bullet referencing the old one, not by editing history). Verified via `grep -n "resolved 2026-08-02" scripts/cam/patterns.md`: the literal marker string no longer appears anywhere the archiver's `RESOLVED_MARKER_RE` regex could match it (only survives as a quoted historical locator phrase inside the UNRELATED, unmarked line-1158 bullet's own prose, which was deliberately left untouched). Full quality spine (typecheck, 5934 tests, check:all incl. coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet/embed-vendor:check) is green; this was a docs-only single-line patterns.md change with no code/test/budget-file impact. All round-1 (US-R1-001..004) and round-2 review findings for CAM-482 are now closed; no known open PRD stories remain flagged for this cycle as of this handoff.
